value.rationale: An exact infinite-parametric minimum-attractor formula independent of arbitrary strictly increasing zero-gap values is a nontrivial structural invariant of sparse binary words. The proof provides optimal positions and a sharp parity obstruction, and the triangular case gives a concrete square-root attractor regime not captured by standard automatic-family classifications.
